Get your first tarot reading today

No experience needed and nothing to prepare except a question. This short guide walks you from "I have never done this" to sitting at the table on 14th Street, a few steps from Fifth Avenue.

See who can read for me todayCall 212-645-0141

  1. Pick fifteen or thirty minutes

    For a first reading, short is fine. Fifteen minutes covers one question; thirty lets you ask a follow-up or two.

  2. Choose walk-in or a booked time

    Booking is the surest way to get a seat today. Walking in can work when a reader is free.

  3. Think of one question

    Something you actually care about. It does not need to be clever.

  4. Sit down and listen

    The reader shuffles, lays cards and talks you through them. Ask anything that is unclear.

  5. Take one thing with you

    Write down the card or sentence that stuck. That is the part worth keeping.
